things my grandmother taught
me about elegance

"never rush.
walk, eat and speak
slowly."

"always bring something
when you visit.
flowers, a cake, a book."

"have one good coat
and take care of it."

"keep learning.
a woman who reads
is never bored."

her books. my phone.
slides.texte_sophia:
"keep learning."

her books. my version:
5 minutes a day on an app
like Sophia instead
of scrolling.

slides.texte_overlay:
save this and call
your grandmother
